sizes.title: Sizes per quality
sizes.intro: What a file of this quality may weigh, in MB per minute. This counts for every profile of this type, as it does in Radarr under Settings. “Preferred” shuts nothing out: between two releases equal in everything else, the one nearer to it wins.
sizes.saved: The sizes are saved. Profiles kept by hand were built again.

formats.title: Custom formats
formats.intro: Building blocks that describe a release. A format gets its score in the profile of a version, not here.
formats.addTitle: Add a format of your own
formats.empty: No formats yet. They come with the first profile from the assistant.
formats.name: Name
formats.becomesOwn: This format came from the guides. As soon as you save it, it is yours, and the guides no longer touch it.
formats.conditionsRule: Conditions of the same kind belong together: the group matches when nothing required in it fails and at least one of them matches. The format matches when every group matches.
formats.noConditions: Without a condition the format matches every release.
formats.testIntro: The name is read the way a search reads it. Nothing is saved.
formats.testStale: The conditions have changed. Test again.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.intro: Every profile of this type: from the assistant, set by hand, or read out of a Radarr or Sonarr.
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. One comes from the assistant on a version, or from reading a connection.
profiles.assignHint: Which profile a version takes is set on the version itself.
